title: November Soda Firing Workshop
source_quote: November Soda Firing Workshop Full Nov 7, 2026 - Nov 21, 2026
evidence_sentence: The soda page lists a November workshop Nov 7–21, 2026 where potters learn fundamentals and fire their work in the soda kiln.
evidence_quote: Come learn the fundamentals of soda firing at our Atmospheric Firing Center in San Gregorio!
summary: Three-week November soda workshop (Nov 7–21) teaches fundamentals; load Nov 7–8, fire Nov 8, unload Nov 21. $195 includes glazes, slips, and materials. Now sold out.
commitment: Load Nov 7 & 8 (9am–3pm), fire Nov 8, unload Nov 21 (9am–3pm)
bring: Bisqued cone 10 clay, ready to glaze
how_to_join: Waitlist available on the soda page
